title: SPECIAL ACCOUNT FOR SUPPORT FOR HIGHER AND LIFELONG EDUCATION ACT
full_text:
SPECIAL ACCOUNT FOR SUPPORT FOR HIGHER AND LIFELONG EDUCATION ACT

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Act is to establish a Special Account for Support for Higher and Lifelong Education and prescribe matters concerning its operation, in order to strengthen universities' capacity to nurture talented persons for the future and to support improvements in their education, research, and operating conditions, the development of universities in local areas, and other related matters. [Amended on December 23, 2025.]

Article 2 (Definitions)
The term "university" used in this Act means any of the following institutions:
1. Schools under the subparagraphs of Article 2 of the Higher Education Act; schools established under other statutes or regulations at an equivalent or higher level; and research institutes affiliated with such schools;
2. Lifelong educational facilities at which academic attainments and degrees equivalent to those of graduates of junior colleges are recognized under Article 31 (4) of the Lifelong Education Act;
3. University hospitals or university dental hospitals established as corporations under other Acts, and research institutes affiliated with such hospitals.

Article 3 (Operation and Management of Special Account)
The Special Account for Support for Higher and Lifelong Education (hereinafter referred to as the "Special Account") shall be operated and managed by the Minister of Education.

Article 4 (Revenue)
The revenue of the Special Account shall consist of the following:
1. Transfers from the general account under Article 6;
2. Transfers from other special accounts and funds;
3. Borrowings under Article 7;
4. Other revenue.

Article 5 (Expenditure)
The expenditure of the Special Account shall consist of the following: [Amended on December 23, 2025.]
1. Expenses necessary for projects to strengthen the education and research capacity of universities;
2. Expenses necessary for national talent-development projects in new technology fields and other areas;
3. Expenses necessary for projects to strengthen universities' capacity for lifelong education, including vocational education;
4. Expenses necessary for projects to develop regional talent and foster universities in local areas for balanced national development;
5. Repayment of the principal of and interest on borrowings under Article 7;
6. Expenses necessary for projects to investigate and analyze higher education financial support programs and their outcomes under Article 7-2 (4) of the Higher Education Act;
7. Other expenses necessary for the operation of the Special Account.

Article 6 (Transfers from General Account)
(1) The Government shall transfer from the general account to the Special Account the amount determined in the budget for the relevant fiscal year from the education tax under the Education Tax Act.
(2) The amount transferred under paragraph (1) shall be the budgeted revenue from the education tax imposed and collected on financial and insurance business entities under Article 3, subparagraph 1, of the Education Tax Act. [Amended on December 23, 2025.]
(3) In addition to the transfer under paragraph (1), the Government shall transfer from the general account to the Special Account the amount determined in the budget for the projects referred to in Article 5.

Article 7 (Borrowings)
(1) Where financial resources for expenditure of the Special Account are insufficient, long-term borrowings may be obtained at the expense of the Special Account within an amount approved by resolution of the National Assembly.
(2) Where the Special Account has a temporary shortage of funds, temporary borrowings may be obtained at the expense of the Special Account.
(3) The principal of and interest on temporary borrowings under paragraph (2) shall be repaid within the relevant fiscal year.

Article 8 (Carryover of Expenditure Budget)
Of the expenditure budget of the Special Account, amounts not disbursed within the relevant fiscal year may, notwithstanding Article 48 of the National Finance Act, be carried over to the following fiscal year and used.

Article 9 (Disposition of Surplus)
Any surplus shown in the settlement of accounts of the Special Account shall be incorporated into revenue for the following fiscal year.

Article 10 (Reserve Fund)
A reserve fund may be appropriated in the expenditure budget of the Special Account to meet unforeseeable expenditures outside the budget or expenditures exceeding the budget.

Article 11 (Reporting to the National Assembly)
(1) The Minister of Education shall examine and evaluate the results of operation of the Special Account for the preceding year and shall submit a report on the results to the competent standing committee of the National Assembly by May 31 each year.
(2) The report under paragraph (1) shall include the following matters:
1. An analysis of the performance of projects under Article 5 and a plan for performance management;
2. Prospects for changes in the environment and financial conditions of projects under Article 5;
3. Medium- and long-term investment goals and directions for projects under Article 5.

Addendum <Act No. 19202, December 31, 2022>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force on January 1, 2023.

Article 2 (Period of Validity)
This Act shall remain effective until December 31, 2030. [Amended on December 23, 2025.]

Addendum <Act No. 21227, December 23, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. Provided, however, that the amended provisions of Article 6 (2) and Article 2 of these Addenda shall enter into force on January 1, 2026.

Article 2 (Amendment of Other Acts)
Part of the Local Education Finance Subsidy Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 3 (2) 2, the phrase "out of the revenue amount" shall be replaced with "out of the revenue amount, the amount prescribed in Article 6 (1) of the Special Account for Support for Higher and Lifelong Education Act, and"; and "the amount and the amount prescribed in Article 6 (1) of the Special Account for Support for Higher and Lifelong Education Act" shall be replaced with "the amount".
